usage: Use for a small labelled collection of independent aria-pressed actions.
accessibility: Group naming plus ToggleButton aria-pressed semantics expose each independent state.
rtl: Roving focus follows logical direction.
touch: Members inherit Button targets.
responsive: Parent layout owns wrapping.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial uncontrolled pressed-value set.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables every toggle member.

props.name: label

summary: Named command toolbar with one roving tab stop, logical arrow/Home/End navigation and a caller-owned pinned overflow slot.
usage: Use for related commands. Toolbar owns roving focus and reachability; callers own which equivalent commands appear in overflow.
accessibility: Uses toolbar/orientation semantics with exactly one roving tab stop across enabled command controls.
rtl: Horizontal ArrowLeft/ArrowRight traversal follows resolved logical direction; vertical toolbars use ArrowUp/ArrowDown.
touch: Never shrinks child Button/IconButton targets and keeps overflow reachable.
responsive: Primary content may scroll while an explicit overflow action stays pinned; Toolbar never silently moves or hides commands.

props.name: overflow
props.description: Caller-owned equivalent overflow action; Toolbar pins it but never silently moves/hides commands.

accessibility: Trigger owns aria-describedby while Tooltip participates in shared Escape/stack lifecycle without stealing focus.
rtl: Placement uses logical alignment.
touch: Touch hover activation is intentionally suppressed.
responsive: Floating placement adapts around viewport edges.

summary: Certified scoped UI environment and runtime boundary for semantic tokens, resolved capabilities, host insets, portals and root-owned services.
usage: Wrap each independent UI tree once. Nested UiRoots are detected automatically, inherit environment preferences/tokens by default, and isolate portal/runtime ownership without a manual scope flag.
accessibility: Owns environment/runtime coordination without inventing application roles. Modal isolation, focus restoration and portal ownership remain local to the nearest UiRoot; reduced motion is resolved per owning Window realm.
rtl: Auto direction inherits the enclosing UiRoot or owning document. Nested roots can override direction explicitly and all public box styling remains logical-property based.
touch: Auto pointer precision/density and modality are observed in the concrete owning Window realm. Coarse-pointer target floors remain independent of visual density.
responsive: Each root measures its own container for adaptive bands. Persistent safe area and transient occlusion remain separate logical host inputs and nested roots inherit/override them predictably.

props.name: className
props.description: Optional host class name. Use semantic component props/tokens for design-system styling.

props.name: clipboardAdapter
props.description: Clipboard adapter scoped to this root; nested roots may provide an independent transport.

props.name: colorScheme
props.description: Native form-control color-scheme preference. Custom themes may override it explicitly; other themes resolve from their palette/system preference.

props.name: cursor
props.description: Root-scoped cursor runtime customization for platform hosts that opt into the shared cursor engine.

props.name: density
props.description: Visual density preference. Auto resolves from pointer precision without device-name sniffing.

props.name: direction
props.description: Logical text/layout direction. Auto inherits the enclosing UiRoot or owning document direction.

props.name: editingBridge
props.description: Host-neutral bridge for editable-text session transport owned by this root.

props.name: instrumentPerformance
props.description: Enables root-scoped frame-performance instrumentation without changing visual semantics.

props.name: modality
props.description: Input-modality preference. Auto tracks keyboard, mouse, touch, and pen activity in the owning Window realm.

props.name: motion
props.description: Motion preference for this runtime scope. System resolves against the owning Window realm.

props.name: occlusion
props.description: Transient host occlusion, such as a virtual keyboard, in logical coordinates with explicit CSS units.

props.name: pointerPrecision
props.description: Pointer precision preference. Auto resolves from the owning Window's coarse-pointer media query.

props.name: safeArea
props.description: Persistent host safe-area insets in logical coordinates with explicit CSS units.

props.name: style
props.description: Root-host escape hatch for integration geometry/CSS variables; component visual APIs remain typed.

props.name: targetFrameRate
props.description: Frame-rate target used by the root motion clock and performance monitor.

props.name: theme
props.description: Theme palette preference for this root. Omit to inherit the enclosing UiRoot, otherwise default to system.

props.name: tokens
props.description: Finite semantic token overrides scoped to this root and inherited by nested roots.

summary: Polymorphic wrapping inline-axis flex composition for intrinsic responsive groups.
usage: Use for peer controls/chips that should wrap naturally as their container contracts instead of branching on viewport/device names.
accessibility: Adds no interaction role of its own; semantic element selection preserves native document structure while visual ordering never changes DOM order.
rtl: Uses logical axes and flex/grid semantics; no left/right public layout API is exposed.
touch: Layout-only; it preserves the target geometry and interaction ownership of child Components.
responsive: Intrinsic and container-first; overflow/min-size controls prevent nested layouts from forcing viewport overflow.

props.name: alignSelf

props.name: as

props.name: className
props.description: Structural escape hatch for host/layout integration; visual values still belong in typed props/tokens.

props.name: flex

props.name: gap

props.name: gridSpan

props.name: justify
